spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "temp"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "umid")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "umid"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "dist")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "dist"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "movimentacao")

spec.title: Última leitura
spec.description: Há quanto tempo chegou o último ponto. Se passar de alguns segundos, o ESP32 parou.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -1d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ultima: int(v: r._time) / 1000000}))

spec.title: Leituras no intervalo
spec.description: Quantos pontos existem no intervalo do topo. Um por segundo, se o ESP32 estiver publicando.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp")
  |> group()
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({leituras: r._value}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp" or r._field == "umid")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "temp", "umid"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")

spec.title: Acelerômetro (x, y, z)
spec.description: Parada, a bag mostra a gravidade: cerca de 9,8 m/s² em um dos eixos.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "accel_x" or r._field == "accel_y" or r._field == "accel_z")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "accel_x", "accel_y", "accel_z"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp" or r._field == "umid" or r._field == "dist" or r._field == "movimentacao")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "device", "temp", "umid", "dist", "movimentacao"])
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "time"})
